answer.reason: Numbers 16 and 26 tell of Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron and how he perished, which the summary does not give.

clauses.english: rose up with Dathan and Abiram against Moses and Aaron
clauses.quote: they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron

clauses.english: was swallowed up with his company when the earth opened her mouth
clauses.quote: the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses

doubts: The marked psalm titles, Chronicles genealogy verses and Jude 1:11 were left out: the titles and genealogies concern his descendants or only list him, and Jude 1:11 only alludes to the rebellion (spelled Core).
NUM 16:49 and NUM 26:9 repeat the same events and were not needed beyond the clauses above.
NUM 27:3 mentions only the company of Korah in passing and adds nothing about Korah himself.
